{{Infobox Boss |type= |image= File:BotW Molduking Model.png |caption= |pronunciation= |title= Divine Beast Tamer's Trial |race= [[Molduga]] |gender= |game= BotW |other= |dungeon= |habitat= [[East Barrens]] |health= 1,500 |weakness= {{List| * Bomb Arrow * Remote Bomb }} |reward= |exp= |theme= "[[Molduga Battle]]" |strategy= |voiceactor= }} The {{Term/Store|Molduking||Series, BotW}} is a [[Sub-Boss]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|'''Molduking'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} It is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. ==Characteristics== {{Compendium/Extract|Molduking}} The Molduking is a giant [[Molduga]] subspecies that gained power by resting underground for centuries, absorbing iron into its skin to bolster its defensive capabilities far beyond its Molduga counterparts.{{Cite|This massive monster swims beneath the desert's sand. It is a subspecies of Molduga that stored up a great deal of energy by sleeping underground for hundreds of years. Its power is superior to Molduga, as its skin is rich with iron and acts as a protective shield.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} Consequently, the Molduking is seen with a [[Gerudo Spear]], [[Golden Claymore]], [[Rusty Broadsword]], [[Rusty Halberd]], and a [[Throwing Spear]] sticking out of its hide, indicating failed attempts to slay it. 100 years ago, [[Urbosa]] faced the Molduking as part of her [[Divine Beast Tamer's Trial]].{{Cite|♪Lightning king of the desert.
{{Color BotW|Blue|Naboris}}'s Champion, the stalwart.♪
♪The hero's power shall grow.
Seek trials {{Color BotW|Blue|monuments}} show.♪
♪One, {{Color BotW|Red|fight the brute of the sand}}.
Two, {{Color BotW|Red|chase rings upon the land}}.♪
♪Three, {{Color BotW|Red|throw the orb underground}}.
Champion, trials abound!♪|Kass|BotW}}{{Cite|Divine Beast Tamer's Trial
{{Big|'''Molduking'''}}|Game Screen|BotW}} Similar to its Molduga counterparts, the Molduking swims beneath the [[Sand]] in the [[East Barrens]], searching for prey. When it detects movement, the Molduking will rush towards the disturbance and leap into the air, attempting to consume the source. Link can trick the Molduking into exposing itself by throwing [[Remote Bomb]]s or shooting [[Bomb Arrow]]s at the sand nearby. If it is struck by either explosive force while in the air, the Molduking will fall to the ground below and temporarily lie stunned. During the "[[EX Champion Urbosa's Song]]" [[Main Quest]], [[Link]] is tasked with slaying the Molduking.{{Cite|I applaud your courage in coming here. The locations that will be revealed to you are of trials that will enhance the power sleeping within. Do not let your guard down...|Monk|BotW}} Once this happens, [[Keive Tala Shrine]] will rise from the Sand nearby. After the Molduking has been defeated, it will reappear in the East Barrens following every [[Blood Moon]]. When Link speaks to [[Teake]] during "EX Champion Urbosa's Song", she mentions there have been sightings of the Molduking in the East Barrens and that [[Traysi]] went to investigate.{{Cite|I hear a strange type of {{Color BotW|Red|Molduga}} was spotted near {{Color BotW|Red|East Barrens}} recently. A Hylian named {{Color BotW|Blue|Traysi}} went there looking for...how did she put it..."a hot scoop."|Teake|BotW}} Traysi can be found on a mesa in the East Barrens, where she shares that [[Gerudo]] have tried fighting the Molduking, but their swords were unable to deal any damage.{{Cite|Apparently the Gerudo soldiers tried fighting it, but normal swords didn't even make a dent.|Traysi|BotW}} When Link defeats the Molduking, Traysi is impressed and asks if she can write about it.{{Cite|Hey, you! I saw everything! I can't believe you were able to defeat that weird {{Color BotW|Blue|Molduga}}... I'm speechless! ME! OK, not really. But this has SCOOP written all over it! Mind if I...write a tell-all about you?!|Traysi|BotW}} However, she takes his silence as a denial.{{Cite|I see. How unfortunate.|Traysi|BotW}} Like the [[Igneo Talus Titan]], the defeat of the Molduking does not count towards its respective [[Medal of Honor]]. ==Nomenclature== The Molduking's name comes from [[Molduga]] and {{Wp|King}}, referencing how it is the strongest Molduga around. {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== * {{Term|Series|Divine Beast Tamer's Trial|link}} * {{Term|Series|Molduga|link}} * {{Term|Series|Sub-Boss|link}} {{Ref}} {{Bosses|BotW}} {{Categories |Sand-Related Enemies |sub-bosses= BotW }}
